input:
We are upgrading a BSP from Linux 6.12 to Linux 6.18 LTS (released Nov 2025). The 6.18 thermal framework step-wise governor was updated to reduce the cooling level earlier when the thermal zone temperature is dropping. Post-upgrade, our sustained-heavy-load test reveals NEW behavior:

  Cooling clamp drops faster, but we see frame-rate judder under 60 fps gaming.

We suspect governor oscillation. How does the updated step_wise behavior interact with thermal-zone trip-point hysteresis width, and what device-tree property should we tune to smooth the bursty-workload case? Which thermal trip-point hysteresis range is recommended?
